references.text: Isaiah 55:1 invites all who are thirsty to come to the water, which can be seen as an invitation to those in need, similar to how Jesus directs his call to those needing healing rather than those who consider themselves righteous.
Psalm 51:17 speaks of a broken and crushed heart that God will not despise, echoing Jesus' message to come to those who recognize their own distress and sinfulness.
Matthew 9:12-13 repeats almost verbatim Mark 2:17, where Jesus explains that he has come to call sinners, not the righteous.
Luke 5:31-32 gives a parallel account to Mark 2:17, where Jesus explains his mission to call sinners to repentance.
